# TrailFusion AI

> TrailFusion AI is the indie app studio of Hiroaki Yuasa. It makes apps for learning, talking, travelling and creating. The flagship is Gokaku! Quest, one study app with 12 courses (Japanese entrance-exam science, social studies, Japanese and math, plus certifications, Japanese, English and driving theory).

Updated: 2026-10-25
Website: https://trailfusionai.com/ (Japanese) and https://trailfusionai.com/en/ (English)
Contact: trailfusionai@gmail.com
App Store publisher name: hiroaki yuasa

## Key facts (App Store Japan, 2026-10-25)
- Apps on the App Store: 12; one more (Mochi) is in review.
- App Store ratings across all apps: 262.
- Gokaku! Quest: 12 courses, 99,075 questions, illustrated atlases for every course; levels 40 and 50 are free, 60 and 70 are Pro.

## Apps
- [Gokaku! Quest](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/) — Entrance-exam science, social studies, Japanese and math, plus certifications and languages. 12 courses in one app. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6775411516
- [Mochi](https://trailfusionai.com/apps.html#mochi) — A soft companion to talk with. Put feelings into words and spend a little time together every day. (in App Store review)
- [Car Concierge](https://trailfusionai.com/car-concierge.html) — Where to rest tonight, parking fees, EV charging and the next destination, on a single map for road trips in Japan. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6751795223
- [Reel Make](https://trailfusionai.com/reelmake.html) — Pick photos and clips. AI builds a vertical video with narration and captions. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6779420680
- [VoiceLink AI Translator](https://trailfusionai.com/voicelink.html) — Speech recognition, translation and summaries run entirely on the device. Nothing you say is sent to a server. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6746684736
- [BuddyTalk](https://trailfusionai.com/buddytalk.html) — Talk with AI until English comes out naturally. An English app focused on speaking practice. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6744263274
- [English Quest](https://trailfusionai.com/eigo-quest.html) — Grammar, vocabulary and English exams, learned through quizzes and explanations. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6782028599
- [Gokaku! FP Quest](https://trailfusionai.com/quest/courses/fp/) — The six areas of the Japanese financial planner exam, with illustrated guides and questions. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6812542387
- [Word Blaster](https://trailfusionai.com/word-blaster.html) — Words fly at you as enemies. A vocabulary shooter for 10 languages. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6745741796
- [Wood Golem](https://trailfusionai.com/wood-golem.html) — A strategy puzzle built on the classic stick-taking game, with a golem who grows as you win. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6739466549
- [Hacking Timer](https://trailfusionai.com/hacking-timer.html) — An interval timer for Apple Watch that keeps a rhythm of focus and rest. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6746063846
